# Demo

Use this skill to demonstrate the release review workflow.

## Steps

1. Open the sample release checklist in this directory.
2. Walk through each checklist item and explain what evidence satisfies it.
3. Summarize which items commonly fail and why.

Stop after the walkthrough. Do not modify the sample data.
